question: Is Skillsoft Percipio worth it for corporate training?
text:
Yes—Skillsoft Percipio can be worth it for corporate training, but mainly when you have a reasonably large workforce and want a broad, centrally managed learning library rather than a small set of highly specialized courses.

Where Percipio is strong

Very broad content: Technology, leadership, business skills, compliance, certifications, and professional development are all covered. Reviewers consistently praise the breadth of the catalog.

Good for enterprise-scale learning: It supports learning paths, skills benchmarking, assignments, progress tracking, certifications, and custom content—useful for L&D teams trying to standardize training across departments or countries.

Strong multinational use case: Content is available in multiple languages, and reviewers particularly highlight AI translation and globally relevant/localized content.

G2

Good mix of learning formats: Courses, videos, books/book summaries, audio, certifications and other formats make it easier to accommodate different learning preferences.

Generally positive user sentiment: Percipio is around 4.1/5 on G2 (100+ reviews) and 4.7/5 on Capterra (11 reviews), although the Capterra sample is much smaller.

Where I'd be cautious

The biggest issue is depth versus breadth.

Percipio gives you a lot of training, but not every course is equally good. Reviews mention uneven course quality, limited hands-on exercises in some areas, and some courses being overly video-centric. 
G
G2
+1

The administrator experience is another potential weakness. Learners generally find the platform easy enough, while administrators sometimes describe reporting and back-end configuration as less intuitive or somewhat cumbersome. 
G
G2
+1

And pricing matters. Current third-party pricing information indicates a self-service Teams offering around $240/user/year, while larger enterprise deployments are quote-based. I'd treat that figure as indicative rather than a guaranteed enterprise price.

companylms.com

My verdict
Situation	Verdict
1,000+ employees needing broad training	Very good fit
Global workforce / multilingual training	Very good fit
Leadership + business + IT + compliance	Very good fit
Certification preparation	Good fit
Deep hands-on technical training	Mixed
Small company with simple training needs	Probably overkill
You need consistently exceptional course quality	Compare alternatives carefully
You mainly need an LMS for your own content	Probably consider cheaper/simpler LMSs

I'd shortlist Percipio for an enterprise L&D program, but I wouldn't buy it solely because it has a huge course catalog. The real question is whether your employees will actually use enough of that catalog to justify the per-seat cost.

If you're comparing Percipio vs LinkedIn Learning vs Coursera for Business vs Udemy Business, I can give you a side-by-side recommendation based on price, content quality, AI/tech training, management features, and ROI.
